discount.formula: W19's Z3 formula, reused: Q_y = sum over the TSO block and the three DSO blocks of every day of year y of the gross settlement-excluded per-block cost (sum of generation_cost + flexibility_cost_internal + load_curtailment_cost + res_curtailment_penalty + ess_usage_cost + detector_penalty_total, as recorded in component_levels_terminal.json); undiscounted Q_y = sum of unweighted * num_years * num_days; V_y = Q_y(0) - Q_y(x); V(r) = sum_y V_y_undiscounted / (1 + r)^(y - 2025); value_to_cost(r) = V(r) / I(x); value - I = V(r) - I(x). Production applies ONE discount factor per representative year to all 5 years of the block (W19 Z3 production_convention); I(x) is paid in 2025 and not discounted.
